    ('discord.exe', '💬 Discord 社区'),
    ('claude.exe', '🤖 Claude 桌面端'),
    ('docker desktop.exe', '🐳 Docker 桌面端'),
    ('windowsterminal.exe', '💻 Windows 终端'),
    ('blackmythwukong.exe', '🐒 黑神话：悟空'),

    ('league of legends.exe', '⚔️ 英雄联盟'),
    ('cities2.exe', '🏗️ 城市：天际线 2'),
    ('slaythespire2.exe', '🃏 杀戮尖塔 2'),
    ('qq.exe', '🐧 QQ 电脑版'),
    ('bilibili.exe', '📺 哔哩哔哩')
),
resource_agg AS (
  SELECT
    r.process_name,
    ROUND(AVG(a.proc_cpu_usage)::numeric, 2) AS "平均 CPU (%)",
    ROUND(MAX(a.proc_cpu_usage)::numeric, 2) AS "峰值 CPU (%)",
    ROUND(AVG(a.proc_gpu_usage)::numeric, 2) AS "平均 GPU (%)",
    ROUND(AVG(a.proc_ram_mb)::numeric, 0) AS "平均内存 (MB)",
    ROUND(MAX(a.proc_ram_mb)::numeric, 0) AS "峰值内存 (MB)",
    ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(a.proc_vram_used_gb, 0))::numeric, 3) AS "平均显存 (GB)",
    COUNT(*) AS "采样点数"
  FROM public.fact_process_activity a
  JOIN public.dim_process_registry r ON a.process_key = r.process_key
  WHERE $__timeFilter(a."timestamp")
  GROUP BY r.process_name
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(pm.alias_name, '⚙️ ' || ra.process_name) AS "进程",
  ra."平均 CPU (%)",
  ra."峰值 CPU (%)",
  ra."平均 GPU (%)",
  ra."平均内存 (MB)",
  ra."峰值内存 (MB)",
  ra."平均显存 (GB)",
  ra."采样点数"
FROM resource_agg ra
LEFT JOIN process_map pm ON LOWER(ra.process_name) = pm.proc_name
ORDER BY ra."平均 CPU (%)" + ra."平均 GPU (%)" + ra."平均内存 (MB)" / 1024.0 DESC
LIMIT 25;

targets.rawSql:
WITH bg_stats AS (
  SELECT
    r.process_name,
    ROUND(AVG(a.proc_cpu_usage)::numeric, 2) AS "CPU 均值 (%)",
    ROUND(MAX(a.proc_cpu_usage)::numeric, 2) AS "CPU 峰值 (%)",
    ROUND(AVG(a.proc_gpu_usage)::numeric, 2) AS "GPU 均值 (%)",
    ROUND(AVG(a.proc_ram_mb)::numeric, 0) AS "内存均值 (MB)",
    ROUND(AVG(a.proc_disk_read_rate_mb + a.proc_disk_write_rate_mb)::numeric, 2) AS "磁盘 IO (MB/s)",
    ROUND(AVG(a.proc_network_send_kb + a.proc_network_recv_kb)::numeric, 1) AS "网络 (KB/s)",
    r.service_name AS "服务名",
    CASE WHEN r.signature_status = 1 THEN '✅ 已签名'
         WHEN r.signature_status = 0 THEN '⚠️ 未签名'
         ELSE '❓ 未知' END AS "签名状态",
    COUNT(*) AS "后台采样数"
  FROM public.fact_process_activity a
  JOIN public.dim_process_registry r ON a.process_key = r.process_key
  LEFT JOIN public.fact_process_context ctx
    ON a.process_key = ctx.process_key
    AND a.os_pid = ctx.os_pid
    AND a."timestamp" >= ctx."timestamp"
    AND (a."timestamp" < ctx.end_timestamp OR ctx.end_timestamp IS NULL)
    AND ctx.is_foreground = 1
  WHERE $__timeFilter(a."timestamp")
    AND ctx.process_key IS NULL
  GROUP BY r.process_name, r.service_name, r.signature_status
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
)
SELECT
  process_name AS "后台内鬼进程",
  "CPU 均值 (%)",
  "CPU 峰值 (%)",
  "GPU 均值 (%)",
  "内存均值 (MB)",
  "磁盘 IO (MB/s)",
  "网络 (KB/s)",
  "服务名",
  "签名状态",
  "后台采样数"
FROM bg_stats
ORDER BY "CPU 均值 (%)" + "GPU 均值 (%)" + "内存均值 (MB)" / 1024.0 DESC
LIMIT 20;

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  r.process_name AS "进程名",
  ROUND(AVG(a.proc_disk_read_rate_mb)::numeric, 3) AS "平均读速 (MB/s)",
  ROUND(MAX(a.proc_disk_read_rate_mb)::numeric, 2) AS "峰值读速 (MB/s)",
  ROUND(AVG(a.proc_disk_write_rate_mb)::numeric, 3) AS "平均写速 (MB/s)",
  ROUND(MAX(a.proc_disk_write_rate_mb)::numeric, 2) AS "峰值写速 (MB/s)",
  ROUND(AVG(a.proc_disk_iops)::numeric, 0) AS "平均 IOPS",
  MAX(a.proc_disk_iops) AS "峰值 IOPS",
  ROUND(SUM((a.proc_disk_read_rate_mb + a.proc_disk_write_rate_mb) * 3.1)::numeric, 1) AS "累计读写 (MB)",
  COUNT(*) AS "采样数"
FROM public.fact_process_activity a
JOIN public.dim_process_registry r ON a.process_key = r.process_key
WHERE $__timeFilter(a."timestamp")
  AND (a.proc_disk_read_rate_mb > 0.001 OR a.proc_disk_write_rate_mb > 0.001 OR a.proc_disk_iops > 0)
GROUP BY r.process_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY AVG(a.proc_disk_read_rate_mb + a.proc_disk_write_rate_mb) DESC
LIMIT 20;

targets.rawSql:
WITH net_stats AS (
  SELECT
    r.process_name,
    ROUND(AVG(a.proc_network_send_kb)::numeric, 1) AS "发送均速 (KB/s)",
    ROUND(AVG(a.proc_network_recv_kb)::numeric, 1) AS "接收均速 (KB/s)",
    ROUND(SUM((a.proc_network_send_kb + a.proc_network_recv_kb) * 3.1 / 1024.0)::numeric, 2) AS "累计流量 (MB)",
    MAX(a.proc_active_connections) AS "最大连接数",
    -- 取最近一条非空 IP
    (SELECT act2.proc_remote_ip_port
     FROM public.fact_process_activity act2
     WHERE act2.process_key = a.process_key
       AND act2.proc_remote_ip_port IS NOT NULL
       AND act2.proc_remote_ip_port != ''
       AND $__timeFilter(act2."timestamp")
     ORDER BY act2."timestamp" DESC
     LIMIT 1) AS "最近远端 IP:Port",
    COUNT(*) AS "采样数"
  FROM public.fact_process_activity a
  JOIN public.dim_process_registry r ON a.process_key = r.process_key
  WHERE $__timeFilter(a."timestamp")
    AND (a.proc_network_send_kb > 0 OR a.proc_network_recv_kb > 0)
  GROUP BY r.process_name, a.process_key
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT
  process_name AS "进程",
  "发送均速 (KB/s)",
  "接收均速 (KB/s)",
  "累计流量 (MB)",
  "最大连接数",
  "最近远端 IP:Port",
  "采样数"
FROM net_stats
ORDER BY "累计流量 (MB)" DESC
LIMIT 20;

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  r.process_name AS "进程",
  ROUND(AVG(a.proc_thread_count)::numeric, 0) AS "平均线程数",
  MAX(a.proc_thread_count) AS "峰值线程数",
  -- 亲和性解码
  CASE
    WHEN MAX(a.proc_cpu_affinity) IS NULL THEN '未采集'
    WHEN MAX(a.proc_cpu_affinity) = -1 THEN '全核 (所有 CPU)'
    WHEN MAX(a.proc_cpu_affinity) >= 0 AND MAX(a.proc_cpu_affinity) <= 32 THEN
      '绑定 ' || MAX(a.proc_cpu_affinity)::text || ' 核'
    ELSE '自定义 (mask=' || MAX(a.proc_cpu_affinity)::text || ')'
  END AS "CPU 亲和性",
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(a.proc_vram_shared_mb, 0))::numeric, 0) AS "共享显存均值 (MB)",
  MAX(COALESCE(a.proc_vram_shared_mb, 0)) AS "共享显存峰值 (MB)",
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(a.proc_vram_used_gb, 0) * 1024)::numeric, 0) AS "专用显存均值 (MB)",
  COUNT(*) AS "采样数"
FROM public.fact_process_activity a
JOIN public.dim_process_registry r ON a.process_key = r.process_key
WHERE $__timeFilter(a."timestamp")
GROUP BY r.process_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY AVG(a.proc_thread_count) DESC
LIMIT 20;

WITH time_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t_from,
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS t_to
),
interval_calc AS (
  SELECT
    GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', make_interval(secs => ceil(extract(epoch from (b.t_to - b.t_from)) / 2000)::int)) AS dt
  FROM time_bounds b
),
nr_events AS (
  SELECT
    a."timestamp" AS time,
    r.process_name AS metric,
    a.is_not_responding AS value
  FROM public.fact_process_activity a
  JOIN public.dim_process_registry r ON a.process_key = r.process_key
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  WHERE a."timestamp" BETWEEN b.t_from AND b.t_to
    AND a.is_not_responding = 1
)
SELECT
  time,
  metric,
  CASE WHEN value = 1 THEN '🔴 无响应' ELSE '🟢 正常' END AS value
FROM nr_events
ORDER BY time ASC;

targets.rawSql:
WITH time_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t_from,
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS t_to
),
process_mem_trend AS (
  SELECT
    r.process_name,
    a.process_key,
    -- 取时间范围前 10% 的平均内存
    AVG(CASE WHEN a."timestamp" < (SELECT t_from + (t_to - t_from) * 0.1 FROM time_bounds)
         THEN a.proc_ram_mb END) AS mem_start,
    -- 取时间范围后 10% 的平均内存
    AVG(CASE WHEN a."timestamp" > (SELECT t_to - (t_to - t_from) * 0.1 FROM time_bounds)
         THEN a.proc_ram_mb END) AS mem_end,
    AVG(CASE WHEN a."timestamp" < (SELECT t_from + (t_to - t_from) * 0.1 FROM time_bounds)
         THEN COALESCE(a.proc_vram_used_gb, 0) END) AS vram_start,
    AVG(CASE WHEN a."timestamp" > (SELECT t_to - (t_to - t_from) * 0.1 FROM time_bounds)
         THEN COALESCE(a.proc_vram_used_gb, 0) END) AS vram_end,
    COUNT(*) AS samples
  FROM public.fact_process_activity a
  JOIN public.dim_process_registry r ON a.process_key = r.process_key
  WHERE $__timeFilter(a."timestamp")
  GROUP BY r.process_name, a.process_key
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
)
SELECT
  process_name AS "进程名",
  ROUND(mem_start::numeric, 0) AS "起始内存 (MB)",
  ROUND(mem_end::numeric, 0) AS "结束内存 (MB)",
  ROUND((mem_end - mem_start)::numeric, 0) AS "内存增量 (MB)",
  CASE WHEN mem_start > 0 THEN ROUND(((mem_end - mem_start) / mem_start * 100)::numeric, 1) ELSE 0 END AS "内存增幅 (%)",
  ROUND(vram_start::numeric * 1024, 0) AS "起始显存 (MB)",
  ROUND(vram_end::numeric * 1024, 0) AS "结束显存 (MB)",
  ROUND((vram_end - vram_start)::numeric * 1024, 0) AS "显存增量 (MB)",
  samples AS "采样数"
FROM process_mem_trend
WHERE mem_start IS NOT NULL AND mem_end IS NOT NULL
  AND (mem_end - mem_start) > 10
ORDER BY (mem_end - mem_start) DESC
LIMIT 15;

targets.rawSql:
WITH time_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS range_start,
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS range_end
),
time_grid AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    b.range_start,
    b.range_end,
    GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', make_interval(secs => ceil(extract(epoch from (b.range_end - b.range_start)) / 1500)::int))
  ) AS grid_time
  FROM time_bounds b
),
fg_keys AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (g.grid_time)
    g.grid_time,
    ctx.process_key,
    ctx.os_pid
  FROM time_grid g
  JOIN public.fact_process_context ctx
    ON g.grid_time >= ctx."timestamp"
    AND (g.grid_time < ctx.end_timestamp OR ctx.end_timestamp IS NULL)
    AND ctx.is_foreground = 1
  ORDER BY g.grid_time, ctx."timestamp" DESC
),
resource_split AS (
  SELECT
    g.grid_time AS time,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fk.process_key IS NOT NULL THEN a.proc_cpu_usage ELSE 0 END) AS "前台进程 CPU (%)",
    SUM(CASE WHEN fk.process_key IS NULL THEN a.proc_cpu_usage ELSE 0 END) AS "后台总 CPU (%)",
    SUM(CASE WHEN fk.process_key IS NOT NULL THEN a.proc_gpu_usage ELSE 0 END) AS "前台进程 GPU (%)",
    SUM(CASE WHEN fk.process_key IS NULL THEN a.proc_gpu_usage ELSE 0 END) AS "后台总 GPU (%)"
  FROM time_grid g
  JOIN public.fact_process_activity a ON a."timestamp" = g.grid_time
  LEFT JOIN fg_keys fk
    ON g.grid_time = fk.grid_time
    AND a.process_key = fk.process_key
    AND a.os_pid = fk.os_pid
  GROUP BY g.grid_time
)
SELECT time, "前台进程 CPU (%)", "后台总 CPU (%)", "前台进程 GPU (%)", "后台总 GPU (%)"
FROM resource_split
ORDER BY time ASC;
